internship.title: React.js Development Internship
internship.description: A role-specific React.js Development Internship where students learn through realistic requirements, implementation, testing, review and delivery.
internship.learningModel: learn -> inspect -> implement -> test -> review -> iterate -> deliver
expectations: Complete every practical and dedicated task.
Verify work instead of assuming it works.
completionRequirements: Explain submitted work during final review.

learningObjectives: Apply the concept to a realistic internship project.

notes.text: Understand repository conventions, feature workflow, component boundaries and review process.

items: Read the requirement or issue.
